name: Ham and the curse on Canaan
charge: Seeing the nakedness of his father and not covering him
summary: Noah, still righteous, drank of the wine with a heavy heart after a hundred years of preaching to a world that drowned. Ham saw his father’s nakedness and mocked him, telling his two brothers outside instead of covering him; Shem and Japheth covered him without looking, applying the laws concerning nakedness, and carried the matter to him as witnesses are bound to do. Noah, a prophet, was shown what his younger son had done and cursed Canaan to be a servant of servants. The curse is servitude, not a colour, and the Messiah was to come through Shem.
offenseFull: Noah began to be a husbandman and planted a vineyard, drank of the wine, and was uncovered within his tent (Genesis 9:20-21). He was still perfect and righteous: a just man falls seven times and rises up again, and one fall does not undo righteousness (Proverbs 24:16). Understand the man’s heart. He had preached repentance for about a hundred years, and everyone he knew outside his own house drowned while he stood behind a door he had not closed himself; strong drink is given to him that is ready to perish, and wine to those that be of heavy hearts (Proverbs 31:6-7; 2 Peter 2:5).

Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father and told his two brethren outside. Shem and Japheth took a garment upon both their shoulders, went backward with their faces turned away, and covered their father, and did not see his nakedness (Genesis 9:22-23). The commandments concerning nakedness were already being kept; Leviticus 18 opens those laws and forbids uncovering the nakedness of a father (Leviticus 18:6-8). Nothing in the text says Ham touched his father. He looked and he talked; he mocked him. His brothers covered without looking, and they also carried the matter to their father, because the law lays the iniquity on a witness who has seen or known a thing and does not utter it (Leviticus 5:1). The honour due a father did not lapse because his weakness was in plain view (Exodus 20:12; Ecclesiasticus 3:10-11).
judgmentFull: Noah was asleep, so how did he know what his younger son had done to him? God speaks once, yea twice, in a dream, in a vision of the night, and reveals his secret to his servants the prophets; Noah was a preacher of righteousness, and the Lord told him (Genesis 9:24; Job 33:14-16; Amos 3:7). Cursed be Canaan: a servant of servants shall he be to his brethren (Genesis 9:25). Read what the curse actually is. It is servitude, not a skin. Every man in that tent was dark, and the first change of colour recorded in the scriptures comes later, with Esau. The sentence names Canaan, and the text does not carry it past the son it names.

Then Noah blessed the Lord God of Shem, and named no other God for the other two: it was revealed that the Messiah and the righteous seed would come through Shem. Japheth would be enlarged and dwell in the tents of Shem, and Canaan would be servant to both (Genesis 9:26-27). Whatever a servant has belongs to his master, which is why the children of Israel taking the land of Canaan was no robbery; the land was already theirs by that word. The sons of Ham are Cush, which is Ethiopia; Mizraim, which is Egypt; Phut, which is Libya; and Canaan, whose land is the land where Jerusalem sits (Genesis 10:6). Ham inhabited what men now call Africa, so the land of Israel is part of Africa; and Israel is of Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, Shemites scattered among the children of Ham (Genesis 9:18-19; Genesis 10:21).

lawsResolved.text: Honor your father and your mother.

text.text: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.
None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the Lord.
The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
Glory not in the dishonour of thy father; for thy father’s dishonour is no glory unto thee.
For the glory of a man is from the honour of his father; and a mother in dishonour is a reproach to the children.
And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
